gramlot-py-server 0.2.5 follows the core 0.2.12: the core object that serves the pages is `GramlotServer`, and the five adapters pass the conformance check of the server protocol GC-230. It requires `gramlot>=0.2.12`.

## Core 0.2.12

- The adapters build the core `GramlotFileServer` (was `FileHost`) and map `ServerCapacity` (was `HostCapacity`) to 503. The core has no aliases for the old names.
- The attribute that holds the core object is `server` in the Uvicorn `Application` and in the Django, Flask and FastAPI `Pages` (was `host`). In the Kajenn `Application` it is `gramlot_server`: `server` is the Kajenn server that owns the application.
- On shutdown the Uvicorn and FastAPI adapters call `close_all()` of the core instead of clearing its page registry directly.
- The Kajenn `Application` overrides `on_shutdown`: it calls `close_all()` when the Kajenn server stops.

## Protocol fixes found by `check_protocol`

- `POST /gramlot/source` whose `method` is missing or not a string answers 400 `Source method must be a string` in the five adapters (was 404).
- FastAPI and Flask: `GET` of `/gramlot/main`, `/gramlot/source` and `/gramlot/close` answers 405 with `Allow: POST` (was 404 `Page not found` from the page route).
- Django: the runtime, page and companion views are `csrf_exempt`, so a `POST` on them answers 405 (was 403 from `CsrfViewMiddleware`). They accept no `POST`.

## Tests

- `tests/<framework>/test_<framework>_conformance.py` starts each adapter with its `serve` in a child process, at the site root without a policy and under `/py` with the strict policy, and runs the core `check_protocol` on the pages `/` and `/orders`: 10 cases, all passing.
- A Kajenn test checks that `on_shutdown` forgets every open page.
- Against the published core 0.2.12: 85 tests pass with every extra; per framework, Uvicorn 17, Django 12, Flask 12, FastAPI 12, Kajenn 16; the repository tests 16. The browser checks pass in Chromium for the five adapters under `/py` and for the gallery of every environment, and the clean install of the wheel passes for the five environments.

## Documentation

- The guides name `GramlotServer` and `GramlotFileServer`, and the attributes `server` and `gramlot_server`.
- GP-110-005 describes `GRAMLOT_DEV`: unset, the runtime URL serves `gramlot.min.js` and each page file runs once per process; `YES` runs the page file again at each opening; `DEBUG` also serves the readable `gramlot.js`. The production checklist of GP-115 asks for `GRAMLOT_DEV` unset.
- The Django, Flask, FastAPI and Uvicorn references list the new 400 and 405 answers.

## Other changes

- The core requirement is `gramlot>=0.2.12`, in the package and in the CI jobs.
